qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.rule: Decoded SWAPGS is admitted only for long-mode CPL0 blocks; legacy modes and nonzero CPL decline atomically before native publication.
admission.implementation: An explicit flag-neutral IR statement exchanges the visible GS base and IA32_KERNEL_GS_BASE context words in either native tier. An append-only context marker publishes both GS MSRs only after a native SWAPGS, preserving byte-for-byte untouched architectural snapshots.
admission.deferred: All other privileged system operations retain their existing interpreter boundaries.

verification.focusedGate: 61 tests in DoryARM64Tier1ABITests, DoryARM64Tier1JITTests, and DoryX86IRTests passed.
verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,446 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Both measured sites match the interpreter in the legacy baseline and tier one, including an intentionally inconsistent untouched IA32_GS_BASE image, a CMP to SWAPGS to JNE native-flags path, and atomic user-mode decline.
verification.abiCoverage: The stable context layout is 53 words; helper-boundary regression coverage proves that the SWAPGS publication marker does not normalize untouched GS state.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, and instruction totals. The elapsed difference is reported for completeness and is not a performance claim.

interpretation: The two measured hot kernel SWAPGS sites are absent from the retained negative-cache sample after operation-wide long-mode CPL0 admission, and the authenticated workload completes. A05.2 remains open because 125,890 of 224,847 full-run tier-one attempts still decline.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
